name: Balgopal Commercial Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Balgopal Commercial Ltd deals in investments in shares and trading of textiles
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company deals as buyers, sellers, suppliers, investor, trader of consumer and household goods and also in shares, debentures, bonds, and securities. Company does trading of sarees from plain to designer and cotton to silk and is planning to venture into trading of other merchandise products through existing chain of Wholesalers and retailers

cons: Stock is trading at 5.69 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -43.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.37% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 2,354 days to 6,537 days
